question: What is JM Vince's strike rate off legal deliveries?

question: What percentage of the legal balls F du Plessis faces go for four or six?

question: Which bowler took the most batter dismissals (excluding run outs) in 2024?
sql: select d.bowler_id, p.name from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.bowler_id where d.outcome = 'W' and m.season_year = 2024 group by all order by count(*) desc, d.bowler_id limit 1

question: Which batter scored the most runs off legal balls in 2024?
sql: select d.batter_id, p.name from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.batter_id where m.season_year = 2024 group by all order by sum(d.runs_batter) desc, d.batter_id limit 1

question: Which batter has the highest strike rate in 2024 among those who faced at least 300 legal balls?
sql: select d.batter_id, p.name from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.batter_id where m.season_year = 2024 group by all having count(*) >= 300 order by sum(d.runs_batter) * 1.0 / count(*) desc, d.batter_id limit 1

question: Which bowler has the highest dot-ball percentage in 2023 among those who bowled at least 300 legal balls?
sql: select d.bowler_id, p.name from legal_deliveries d join matches m using (match_id) join players p on p.player_id = d.bowler_id where m.season_year = 2023 group by all having count(*) >= 300 order by avg((d.outcome = 'dot')::int) desc, d.bowler_id limit 1
